_comment: Daily strategy ranking settings — single source of truth for all ranking scripts. 9/22 user 收緊版 applied.

schedule._note: Single daily run at 00:00 HKT. Previous 3x (00:00/12:00/20:00 UTC) over-triggered LLM iteration and produced duplicated rankings. Use workflow_dispatch for manual re-rank.

sort_criteria._comment: 9/22 feedback: Total $ + PF 排行，R 只作附註
sort_criteria._r_note: Total R appears as a footnote column (rightmost), not in main sort. 種田要睇$同單筆風險，R係效率指標。

award_eligibility._detail: Strategy with n_trades < 10 is shown in the table but does NOT receive 🥇/🥈/🥉. Display with '  ' (no medal). Prevents n=2 B1 cases from taking silver due to lucky 1/1 WR.

ticker_split._detail: Add a Ticker column to the ranking table. Same ticker = consecutive rows (stable grouping, but global sort order is preserved across tickers). BTC口數扭曲 RSI/H ranking, 用拆欄後一目了然.

lookback._note: 20d for daily full-pipeline ranking, 7d for rolling (naturally derived from closed trades within window).

daily_settlement._comment: Per-agent daily settlement — symmetric rules (升1lv 達標 / 降1lv 唔達標). 9/22 + 10/07 user directives.
daily_settlement._decrement_note: 10/07 user: '唔達標要 -1 lv'. Symmetric demote: PF≤1 AND WR≤0.5 AND RR≤1 (all 3 must fail) with n≥10. Floored at min_level=1.
daily_settlement._neutral_zone: If 1-2 of 3 conditions fail (but not all), strategy stays flat. Avoids volatility from mixed signals.
daily_settlement._max_level_note: 2026-10-14 user: 不設上限。無限 lv — 信任等級唔應該有天花板，因為 agent 可以持續積累有效樣本。
daily_settlement._evidence_note: 升級必須見到新交易：n 必須大於上次升級時的 n。否則同一組數據每日重複 +1，一年就會推到 lv300+。
daily_settlement._consecutive_note: 連續 2 日達標先升級，避免單日噪音觸發。
daily_settlement._window_note: 2026-10-20 user: 7d → 14d. Rationale: the 7-day window gave levels that contradicted the long-run evidence. On 2026-10-20, RSI-Div held the best lifetime record (180 trades, PF 1.52, +47.9R) and was graded B by the per-agent iteration, yet sat at lv1 because its 7-day window held 3 trades and PF 0.00. Meanwhile 3-Pushes sat at lv3 on a 9-trade 7-day window. A trust level decided on a handful of trades is not a trust level. Fourteen days roughly doubles the sample and brings the settlement horizon closer to the horizon the LLM iteration reasons over.

_history.v5.3_2026-10-07: Applied 9/22 收緊版: sort by Total $ + PF; n<10 no medal; ticker column.
_history.prior: Original settings: sort by PF → Total R → WR; no n<10 filter; no ticker column.
